title: Go Module Provenance Predicate
description: Predicate describing a Go module version fetched from the Go module proxy and verified against the Git tag it was released from. The attestation subject is the module zip.

commit.description: The Git commit the release tag resolves to, as seen in the CI checkout.

originCommit.description: The Git commit reported by the Go proxy (Origin.Hash) for the downloaded module.

tagMatchesProxy.description: True when commit equals originCommit. The producing action fails the job otherwise, so a signed attestation always has this set to true.

moduleSum.description: The Go module content checksum (Sum) from go mod download -json.

goModSum.description: The go.mod checksum (GoModSum) from go mod download -json.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the predicate was generated.
